description: This file defines a template class 'unique_function' implementing a move-only, type-erased callable wrapper with small buffer optimization, along with internal task detail classes and utility functions.

classes.name: unique_function
classes.description: A move-only, type-erased callable wrapper with small buffer optimization, supporting custom buffer sizes and optional heap allocation restrictions.

classes.name: oper_table_t
classes.description: Base virtual table for move/call/destroy operations over stored functors.

classes.name: empty_table_t
classes.description: Specialization of oper_table_t for empty functor storage.

classes.name: smallbuffer_table_t
classes.description: Oper table for functors stored in the small buffer.

classes.name: heap_table_t
classes.description: Oper table for functors stored on the heap.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the stored functor with provided arguments.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the unique_function is empty.

methods.name: is_in_small_buffer
methods.description: Checks if the stored functor resides in the small buffer.
